_doc: Rules applied by hooks/guard.py (PreToolUse, refuses even in bypass mode).
deny_tools: regexes on the full MCP tool name (mcp__<server>__<name>).
deny_command_regex: regexes on each Bash segment (after stripping sudo/env/rtk).

Recursive rm: refused when the target is /, a system folder, home, a path at <= home_max_depth levels under home (every project folder), a volume at <= volumes_max_depth levels, a protected prefix, or .git. Tolerated under tmp_prefixes.
git: push --force/--delete/+ref/--mirror to protected_branches (or to the current branch when there is no refspec), branch -D of a protected branch, and the switches of the git block.
Shipped deny_tools are examples (Hostinger and GitHub MCP servers); adapt them to your own MCP servers.
Temporary disabling by the human: touch ~/.claude/guard.off. Log: ~/.claude/guard.log.
